# dsh-annotate-sync

> Open an HTML preview in DeepSeek Harness and the annotation overlay is already there.
> Pick eleme

nts, write notes, hand the batch to the agent, and the agent edits the
> source file by path. No ser
ver, no `<script>` tag, no target picker.
## What it is
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that takes over `.html` / `.htm` document previews:

- open any HTML file in the right-sidebar **Files** panel (including one the agent just
generated) a

nd the **点选批注 / Mark** overlay appears automatically;
- hover highlight, click an element, write a n

sc`, or press **Send to Agent**, and the batch goes into the
current conversation as one structured

hat HTML/CSS directly;
- after the file changes the preview rebuilds; annotations stay; the agent ca

n call
`set_annotation_status` when done.

The old Agentation demo experience is preserved, without manually adding
`agentation.js`, without th
e 8765 sync server, and without a local-service list to pick.

## Use

1. Restart DSH.
2. Open any `.html` file from the right-sidebar **Files** panel — or open the bundle

d
`demo/index.html` to try it.
3. The floating **点选批注 / Mark** button appears in the preview; click

it and then
click an element.
4. Write the note and press `Enter`; `Esc` leaves picking.
5. **Auto-s

end** is on by default: leaving picking sends the batch into the current
conversation. You can also

press **Send to Agent** at any time, or turn auto-send off.
6. The agent reads the annotations and e

dits the source file; the preview refreshes when
the file changes.
7. If the agent does not mark the

m, say "apply my annotations" so it calls
`read_annotations`.

The toolbar above the preview shows the file name, pending count, send, auto-send and
clear.
## Annotation data
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Store: `~/.dsh/annotate-sync/annotations.json` plus readable `annotations.md`.
Legacy v0/v1/v2 files

migrate to v3 automatically; old HTTP-page annotations remain
readable.
## Model tools
| Tool | Purpose |
| `read_annotations({ status?, pageUrl?, includeDone? })` | Read annotations; pending by default; Ma

rkdown includes `文件：<path>` per file |
| `set_annotation_status({ ids?, status, all?, pageUrl? })` |

Mark applied (or back to pending) after editing |
| `clear_annotations({ pageUrl? })` | Clear all,
optionally per file |
## Configuration
`config` in `cordis.patch.yml`:
| Field | Default | Purpose |

| `dir` | `~/.dsh/annotate-sync` | annotation storage directory |
| `route` | `/__dsh-annotate-sync`

| internal API/overlay prefix |
| `legacyRoute` | `/api/annotate-sync/annotations` | old sync bridg

e; empty disables |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `262144` | request body cap |
| `tool` | `true` | register th

es |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `262144` | request body cap |
| `tool` | `true` | register the model tools |
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- The iframe stays `sandbox="allow-scripts"` with an opaque origin; the overlay and the
document com

ponent only exchange `postMessage`; the parent validates `event.source`
plus the channel.
- Relative

CSS/JS are read through DSH's workspaceFiles and packed into the blob, same as
the builtin preview.
- No extra HTTP server is started and no network requests are injected into the page.
## Known limitations

- A page CSP that blocks external scripts also blocks the overlay; the preview itself
still renders.

- The custom renderer always allows the page's own scripts (the overlay needs them); it
is not gate

d by the builtin interactive-preview setting.
- Elements inside cross-origin iframes or closed shado

w roots cannot be picked.
- Only `.html` / `.htm` are taken over; other document types keep the buil

tin preview.
- Pins rely on CSS selectors and geometry; large DOM changes can misplace a pin, while
the note and file path remain.
## Upgrading from 1.x

v2 removes the local-service preview and the right-sidebar annotation panel. The old
`annotations.js

on` migrates; the legacy `/api/annotate-sync/annotations` bridge stays.
`sync-server.mjs` is no long

es; the legacy `/api/annotate-sync/annotations` bridge stays.
`sync-server.mjs` is no longer needed.
